name: Cardinal B-spline wavelets
definition: A class of semi-orthogonal bases used in computer graphics for their strict local support, smooth shape, symmetry, and fast decay in frequency domain.
summary: Cardinal B-spline wavelets are semi-orthogonal bases for volume rendering that offer smooth shapes, strict local support, and fast frequency decay, distinguishing themselves from orthogonal wavelets via semi-orthogonal duals for perfect reconstruction.
